# The Third Era: Antizionism and the History of Jew-Hatred

> A historical and educational exhibition presented by Stop Antizionism, an initiative of Cohesion Partnership, developed under the scholarly leadership of Dr. Naya Lekht.

## Status
- Teaser: the digital exhibition is coming soon; a physical exhibition is planned for 2027.
- The Three Eras opening-room draft describes the digital exhibition as available online.
- The venue and exact physical opening date are not confirmed in the supplied documents.

## Three Eras of Jew-Hatred
- Religious (Antijudaism): religious Jew-hatred rooted in antiquity.
- Racial (Antisemitism): racial Jew-hatred that emerged as a modern ideology in the nineteenth century.
- National (Antizionism): the reinvention of centuries-old anti-Jewish libels targeting the Jewish collective — its people, national identity, and state.
